name: icq-nostalgia
description: Claude Code dressed as a 2007 instant messenger: mint theme, glossy title bar, blossom backdrop, colored sender names, a status flower and a chime when Claude needs you.

nickname.title: Your nickname
nickname.description: The name shown above your messages. Empty: your OS user name.

soundFile.title: Custom sound (.wav)
soundFile.description: Absolute path to a .wav file to play instead of the built-in chime, e.g. a classic messenger sound you own. Empty: sounds/custom.wav in the mod folder if present, else the built-in chime.

turnSound.title: Sound when Claude replies
turnSound.description: Play the message sound when Claude finishes a reply (permission prompts and questions always ding).

minTurnSeconds.title: Reply sound after (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Only ding for replies that took at least this long, so quick answers stay quiet.

volume.title: Volume (macOS)
volume.description: 0 mutes, 1 is normal, up to 4. Windows plays at system volume.
